title: Egg Bhurji Toast
description: Spicy scrambled eggs on crispy toast
instructions_pipe: Chop the onion and green chili|Heat the oil and fry the onion for 2 minutes|Add the eggs and salt and stir until set|Toast the bread and top it with the eggs

title: Chira Poha, Bangladeshi style
description: Soft flattened rice with potato and peanuts
instructions_pipe: Rinse the chira and drain it|Fry the onion and diced potato until soft|Add turmeric and salt then the chira|Mix gently for 3 minutes and squeeze lemon on top

title: Spinach Garlic Pasta
description: Buttery pasta with spinach and garlic
instructions_pipe: Boil the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes|Melt the butter and fry the sliced garlic|Add the spinach until it wilts|Mix in the pasta and season with pepper
